required.input: Establish a deterministic frozen-fixture baseline using the Phase 2 Celery-delivered personal coordinator; then stop Celery worker and scheduler, retain Redis for 4A, and invoke UI and manual command sequentially.
required.expected: Managed-child execution preserves the personal baseline's input identity, article/event associations, terminal state, and published outputs or controlled partial result. No broker publish is required. Original legacy New York reports are excluded from this parity comparison.
required.actual_and_evidence: Actual registered Celery baseline, then exact-owned worker/Beat stopped; CLI start/retry and browser retry succeed using managed children with Redis retained. [Accepted parity](phase-4a-20261004/transport-parity-accepted.json) compares frozen input IDs/payload, article/event associations, terminal state, report sections/evidence and paid rows. All three normalized outputs have SHA-256 `450869426f388e265ccc7f0b5613674d80d01096b0f615ca3def9fe5a5f6a719`. [Stop inventory](phase-4a-20261004/worker-scheduler-accepted-stopped.json), [manual start](phase-4a-20261004/manual_accepted-cli-result.json), [retry](phase-4a-20261004/child_accepted-cli-result.json), [browser observation](phase-4a-20261004/browser-accepted-retry.txt). Feeds/model responses are deterministic synthetic fixtures.

required.input: Send two start requests for the same run simultaneously.
required.expected: One logical run/attempt/child; the other response identifies the existing run. No doubled admission or paid dispatch.
required.actual_and_evidence: [Two actual simultaneous HTTP starts](phase-4a-20261004/concurrent-api-accepted-result.json) return 202, the same run, and subprocess in both responses; one logical attempt, one actual child, one article/event, zero paid requests. The committed queue intent is truthful before delivery.

required.input: Compete across different dates, API and CLI, or direct Celery and personal entry points.
required.expected: One global owner; forbidden mode receives a clear rejection before mutation/paid work. Legacy scheduled ingestion cannot bypass the guard.
required.actual_and_evidence: [Accepted gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml) proves concurrent different-date claims, same-date idempotency and one global owner. Supported maintenance/legacy/standalone writers and wrong transport/mode are rejected before mutation/provider work; [affected units](phase-4a-20261004/accepted-units.xml) cover alternate entries. No unsupported SQL editor is treated as a parallel writer.

required.input: Delay child claim past the two-minute handoff lease, explicitly recover, then release old child.
required.expected: Old delivery token is rejected. Only the replacement can acquire running ownership.
required.actual_and_evidence: A real delayed child queries the replacement generation after explicit authored-clock queued expiry/recovery and is rejected; only the new child claims. [Actual lifecycle observations](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml). Production handoff is 120 seconds; expiry is accelerated in this test.

required.input: Inject a graceful deadline during an item/provider operation.
required.expected: No next item/stage begins; the run unwinds and records failure where possible. Broad exception handlers cannot turn cancellation into continued processing.
required.actual_and_evidence: Fatal feed/composition cancellation prevents the next call/stage; insufficient remaining call budget prevents dispatch/reservation. Broad handlers propagate cancellation. Accepted fault cases use real PostgreSQL with scripted provider responses; actual SIGTERM/SIGINT cleanup is also exercised. [Gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml), [units](phase-4a-20261004/accepted-units.xml).

required.input: Hang the runner; kill its supervisor; test with accelerated equivalents of 25/30/35 minutes.
required.expected: Independent watchdog ends the child by its original hard deadline. Lease cannot be renewed silently; retry is only permitted under the explicit recovery rule.
required.actual_and_evidence: Real launcher loss leaves the independent watchdog enforcing the original hard deadline and killing the owned child group/descendant. Fixed leases have no renewal and recovery remains explicit. The accepted launcher-loss child exited about 48 ms after its original deadline. High-timeout blocked database bootstrap exited about 54 ms after its original handoff with no running claim or provider call. [OS observations](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml). Test-only deadlines scale 25/30/35 minutes to 2.5/3/3.5 seconds; this is not a 30-minute endurance run.

required.input: Old attempt returns from a provider after takeover; attempt event/report writes and a failure-state write.
required.expected: Each stale business transaction is rejected; newer outcome remains unchanged. Its already incurred request cost remains reconcilable.
required.actual_and_evidence: Production RSS/embedding/composition callbacks return after takeover; every stale business/publication/terminal write is rejected and the newer outcome survives. Late incurred usage reconciles accounting only. [Fourteen independent fault integration cases rerun in accepted gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml). Provider responses and amounts are synthetic.

required.input: Lose PostgreSQL mid-run and reconnect after ownership has changed.
required.expected: No new paid dispatch while DB is unavailable; old token cannot resume writes. No reservation or input freeze disappears.
required.actual_and_evidence: [Literal PostgreSQL pause/unpause](phase-4a-20261004/postgres-outage-result.json) in a separate owned instance stops new handoff, retains frozen inputs/$0.020 reservation, rejects the old token after explicit replacement and permits $0.005 accounting-only reconciliation. No external provider call occurred. Lease expiry is accelerated; the database outage is physical. [Exact cleanup](phase-4a-20261004/outage-cleanup.json).

required.input: Normal shutdown, Ctrl-C, hard crash, then app restart.
required.expected: Bounded child cleanup; durable interrupted/retry state; no automatic replacement or new allowance. Saved items and published history remain accessible.
required.actual_and_evidence: Actual child SIGTERM cleanup took 0.229 seconds and CLI SIGINT cleanup 0.595 seconds; interrupted state stays durable, without automatic replacement. [Accepted OS gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml). [Actual API restart](phase-4a-20261004/restart-proof.json) preserves all nine compared business tables, Saved/published history and run count; [browser Saved observation](phase-4a-20261004/browser-saved-restart.txt). This is a retained component experiment; final OS/control/regression gates verify current behavior separately. Its earlier whole-source snapshot is not represented as the accepted epoch.

required.input: Switch modes during an active run, then once genuinely idle.
required.expected: Active switch is rejected; idle switch is durable and invalidates stale launch tokens. Mode mismatch on startup blocks writes without deleting records.
required.actual_and_evidence: Active/unknown child ownership blocks switching; exact old-child exit updates only its retained lifetime. Genuinely idle switch increments generation, rejects stale delivery and persists mode; mode mismatch blocks both transports. [Accepted control/fault gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml), [restored idle legacy switch](phase-4a-20261004/backup-restore-result.json).

required.input: Back up/restore a populated database to a disposable instance; switch to previous supported runtime mode.
required.expected: Saved events, articles, report versions, spending, and run/snapshot identities are retained and readable. Rollback does not drop new tables or revive old unguarded writers.
required.actual_and_evidence: Three populated 0022-to-0023 upgrades preserve legacy/queued/running mode, prior rows, ownership and fixed deadlines. [Accepted migration gate](phase-4a-20261004/phase4a-accepted.xml). [Actual populated dump/restore](phase-4a-20261004/backup-restore-result.json) compares all 91 public tables exactly, preserves Saved/articles/report versions/run/snapshot IDs and known/uncertain obligations, checks readable endpoints, then selects legacy mode without dropping data. This is a retained populated component experiment, supplemented by the final migration/control/regression gates. Its earlier whole-source snapshot is not represented as the accepted epoch.

excluded_4B.input: Stop Redis as well as Celery/Beat, then launch 4B.
excluded_4B.expected: Only app/PostgreSQL persist; real browser reading/saving/update/brief/export work; health says Redis/Celery not required.

excluded_4B.input: Repeated fresh subprocesses issue provider calls; overflow local cache; restart app.
excluded_4B.expected: Empty-start rate buckets respect configured pacing; cache stays bounded; spending/quotas remain durable and unchanged by cache loss.

excluded_4B.input: Load a browser route and an unknown API route from the same app address.
excluded_4B.expected: Browser interface loads; API response retains its actual error status/content type rather than returning frontend HTML.

proof_boundaries: deterministic synthetic feed and model responses
accelerated OS deadline and lease expiry tests
retained restart/outage/restore component experiments supplemented by final gates; earlier whole-source snapshots not represented as final epoch
